names.legendary: The Processor That Made Every Soup

lore.common: Whirs loudly for exactly as long as it takes to make the cat leave the room.
lore.uncommon: Has nine attachments, and nobody in the house knows what seven of them are for.
lore.rare: Turns a whole bag of carrots into confetti in one pulse, whether that was wanted or not.
lore.epic: Chopped so much for a party that the fridge was full of dips and nobody could find the milk.
lore.legendary: Blended so many soups in one winter that the neighbours could tell the flavour by the noise.

names.legendary: The Mixer That Whisked a Wedding Cake

lore.common: Buzzes in the hand and makes the whole arm feel like it is humming.
lore.uncommon: Flicks a little cake batter onto the nearest shirt every time it starts.
lore.rare: Whips cream so fast that it turns into butter before anyone can stop it.
lore.epic: Was switched to top speed in a full bowl, and the ceiling had cake on it for a week.
lore.legendary: Whisked every layer of a five-tier wedding cake and never once needed a rest.

names.legendary: The Machine That Made Every Flavour

lore.common: Churns slowly for a whole hour while the whole family hovers around it.
lore.uncommon: Takes so long that everyone eats biscuits while they wait and is too full for ice cream.
lore.rare: Freezes anything put into it, including a spoon that was left inside by mistake.
lore.epic: Made ice cream for a whole street party and ran out just as the last child queued.
lore.legendary: Made a new flavour every day for a whole summer and never made the same one twice.

names.legendary: The Juicer That Squeezed an Orchard

lore.common: Spits pulp into one cup and juice into another, mostly where they should go.
lore.uncommon: Takes ten minutes to make a glass of juice and twenty minutes to clean.
lore.rare: Squeezes every drop from anything it touches, so the fruit comes out as dry as paper.
lore.epic: Sprayed orange juice across the kitchen at breakfast, and everyone smelled of oranges all day.
lore.legendary: Squeezed so much fruit in one summer that a whole orchard came round to say thank you.

names.legendary: The Mixer That Raised a Bakery

lore.common: Sits heavy on the counter and only moves on baking days.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its way across the worktop when the dough is too stiff.
lore.rare: Kneads dough so powerfully that the whole counter shakes along with it.
lore.epic: Shook so hard making bread that it walked itself to the edge of the counter.
lore.legendary: Mixed so many cakes for the school fete that the head teacher gave it a medal.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Was Never Empty

lore.common: Holds cereal, soup and, on bad days, a few loose crumbs at the bottom.
lore.uncommon: Rings like a bell whenever a spoon is tapped on its edge.
lore.rare: Sloshes anything poured into it over the side the moment it is carried.
lore.epic: Was filled with so much porridge that it slid off the table and painted the floor.
lore.legendary: Has been filled with so many dinners that it is the first thing anyone grabs when they're hungry.

names.legendary: The Colander That Lost No Noodles

lore.common: Has a hundred tiny holes and still lets one piece of pasta slip through.
lore.uncommon: Gets worn as a hat by every child who finds it in the cupboard.
lore.rare: Pours out steam so thick that whoever is draining the pasta vanishes for a second.
lore.epic: Let a whole pan of spaghetti slide into the sink, and dinner was rescued strand by strand.
lore.legendary: Drained so much pasta at a big family dinner that the sink applauded with a gurgle.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Washed the Harvest

lore.common: Is half bowl and half colander, and nobody can decide which half it prefers.
lore.uncommon: Lets water drip through onto the counter whenever someone forgets to hold it over the sink.
lore.rare: Rinses fruit so thoroughly that it washes off the stickers as well.
lore.epic: Washed every berry from a strawberry farm visit, and the kitchen smelled like summer.
lore.legendary: Rinsed a whole allotment harvest in one go, and the slugs gave up and went home.

names.legendary: The Sieve That Made It Snow Indoors

lore.common: Taps out flour in a soft little cloud that drifts across the counter.
lore.uncommon: Keeps one lump in its mesh no matter how hard it is tapped.
lore.rare: Sifts flour so finely that it floats across the kitchen like a fog.
lore.epic: Sifted so much flour for a birthday cake that everyone in the kitchen went grey.
lore.legendary: Made it snow in the kitchen in July, and the children built a tiny floury snowman.

names.legendary: The Strainer That Saved the Gravy

lore.common: Catches tea leaves and pips before they reach the cup.
lore.uncommon: Hangs on the mug's edge and tips in whenever someone looks away.
lore.rare: Catches lumps so well that even the lumpiest gravy comes out silky smooth.
lore.epic: Rescued the gravy at a family dinner so neatly that nobody knew it had gone wrong.
lore.legendary: Saved a whole pot of lumpy custard just in time for the school dinner ladies' party.

names.legendary: The Grinder That Woke the Building

lore.common: Rattles and roars for ten seconds, filling the kitchen with a rich smell.
lore.uncommon: Goes off at six in the morning, always when the rest of the house is asleep.
lore.rare: Grinds so loudly that everyone in the flat knows it's coffee time.
lore.epic: Woke the whole building at dawn, and every neighbour came down with a mug.
lore.legendary: Has ground so many beans that the whole street wakes up to its smell before their alarms.

names.legendary: The Frother That Made a Cloud

lore.common: Buzzes in the jug and turns milk into a fluffy hat for the coffee.
lore.uncommon: Sprays a little milk on the wall whenever it is lifted out too soon.
lore.rare: Froths so much that the foam rises over the mug like a little mountain.
lore.epic: Was left on so long that the foam climbed out of the jug and across the counter.
lore.legendary: Made a foam so tall and fluffy that a child said it was a real cloud and tried to pat it.

names.legendary: The Maker That Fizzed a Party

lore.common: Gurgles and buzzes as it fills a bottle with tiny fizzy bubbles.
lore.uncommon: Makes water so fizzy that it tickles the nose before it reaches the mouth.
lore.rare: Fizzes everything so much that the bottle has to be opened outside.
lore.epic: Fizzed a bottle so hard that the kitchen ceiling got a sparkling shower.
lore.legendary: Fizzed enough drinks for a whole birthday party, and every guest burped in harmony.

names.legendary: The Grinder That Spiced a Feast

lore.common: Twists out pepper in tiny flakes that settle on everything.
lore.uncommon: Gets twisted over every plate until someone sneezes.
lore.rare: Grinds spice so fine that it floats across the table and tickles every nose.
lore.epic: Was twisted once too many times at dinner, and the whole table sneezed together.
lore.legendary: Spiced a whole wedding feast and every guest said it was the best dinner of their lives.

names.legendary: The Jug That Was Always Full

lore.common: Drips slowly through its filter and always takes longer than anyone hoped.
lore.uncommon: Is always nearly empty when somebody else used it last.
lore.rare: Makes water so clear and cold that everyone forgets about other drinks.
lore.epic: Was refilled so often on a hot day that the tap was given a rest.
lore.legendary: Was always full, every time anyone looked, and the family still doesn't know who refills it.

names.legendary: The Fork That Never Dropped a Pea

lore.common: Lives in the drawer with the others and is always the first to be used.
lore.uncommon: Clatters on the floor at every meal, and somebody always says "a visitor is coming".
lore.rare: Spears food so quickly that the last chip on the plate is gone before it is offered.
lore.epic: Started a fork duel over the last roast potato, and the dog won.
lore.legendary: Lifted a single pea to a toddler's mouth a thousand times without ever dropping it.

names.legendary: The Freezer With Last Year's Peas

lore.common: Hums in the garage and holds a frozen mystery at the bottom of every pile.
lore.uncommon: Freezes its lid shut so tightly that opening it takes two people.
lore.rare: Hides food so deep under ice that anything put in it disappears until spring.
lore.epic: Was emptied in a defrost, and the family ate frozen pies for a fortnight.
lore.legendary: Still holds a bag of peas from so long ago that its label is in a different alphabet.

names.legendary: The Maker That Iced a Heatwave

lore.common: Drops ice cubes into its tray with a clatter whenever it feels like it.
lore.uncommon: Drops a cube at night, so everyone thinks there is a burglar.
lore.rare: Makes so much ice that the freezer drawer won't close any more.
lore.epic: Filled a whole party's drinks so fast that the guests had chattering teeth.
lore.legendary: Made enough ice to cool a whole street during a heatwave, and the kids built an igloo.

names.legendary: The Fridge That Fed a Whole Floor

lore.common: Hums quietly in a bedroom, with one drink and a forgotten yoghurt inside.
lore.uncommon: Gets raided at midnight by someone who said they weren't hungry.
lore.rare: Keeps snacks so close to the bed that nobody ever goes downstairs again.
lore.epic: Held a whole feast for a sleepover, and nobody went to the kitchen once.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole student floor for a week of exams and never ran out of milk.

names.legendary: The Cooler That Kept Its Cool

lore.common: Hums softly with its bottles lined up behind a glass door.
lore.uncommon: Fogs its glass door every time somebody opens it to look.
lore.rare: Keeps everything so perfectly cold that nobody dares to change its settings.
lore.epic: Kept its cool in a heatwave so well that the family sat beside it to read.
lore.legendary: Kept perfectly cool through a power cut, a heatwave and a very long dinner party.

names.legendary: The Pan That Flipped Every Pancake

lore.common: Sizzles merrily the moment butter touches it.
lore.uncommon: Spatters a little hot oil onto the cooker every time.
lore.rare: Flips a pancake so high that the cook has to look up to catch it.
lore.epic: Flipped a pancake so high on pancake day that it stuck to the ceiling until supper.
lore.legendary: Flipped every pancake perfectly for a whole street's pancake race, and won the race too.

names.legendary: The Knife That Carved a Feast

lore.common: Sits safely in the knife block until a grown-up needs to slice the bread.
lore.uncommon: Gets blunt from slicing tomatoes and needs sharpening every other week.
lore.rare: Slices bread so thinly that every slice can be seen through.
lore.epic: Carved a whole Sunday roast so neatly that the family argued over who got the last slice.
lore.legendary: Carved a huge feast for a family reunion and gave every one of forty plates a perfect slice.

names.legendary: The Bread Maker That Woke the House

lore.common: Thumps softly in the night as it kneads tomorrow's bread.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when the bread is ready, which is always in the middle of a film.
lore.rare: Fills the house with such a lovely bread smell that everyone wakes up hungry.
lore.epic: Baked a loaf so huge that it pushed the lid open and peeked out.
lore.legendary: Baked bread every morning for a year, and nobody in the family needed an alarm clock.

names.legendary: The Oven That Toasted Everything

lore.common: Toasts, grills and bakes in a box no bigger than a shoebox.
lore.uncommon: Drops crumbs into its tray until they glow a little when it is on.
lore.rare: Bakes things so unevenly that one half is golden and the other half is pale.
lore.epic: Made cheese on toast for a whole sleepover, and the smell woke the parents.
lore.legendary: Toasted everything from crumpets to cupcakes for twenty years and never burned a slice.

names.legendary: The Oven That Baked a Thousand Pizzas

lore.common: Glows orange in the garden and makes everyone suddenly fancy pizza.
lore.uncommon: Bakes a pizza in ninety seconds, which is always ten seconds too long.
lore.rare: Crisps a pizza base so perfectly that everyone wants one more slice.
lore.epic: Baked so many pizzas at a garden party that the guests ran out of plates.
lore.legendary: Baked a pizza so big that it had to be carried out on a door.

names.legendary: The Plate That Never Chipped

lore.common: Holds dinner, gets washed up and waits in the cupboard for tomorrow.
lore.uncommon: Has one tiny chip on the edge that everybody always turns towards somebody else.
lore.rare: Makes every meal served on it look slightly bigger and more delicious.
lore.epic: Was spun on a finger at a party, and the whole family tried to copy and broke two others.
lore.legendary: Has served a thousand dinners and never got a single chip, scratch or crack.

names.legendary: The Pot That Fed Everyone

lore.common: Bubbles away on the cooker with its lid rattling like it's trying to talk.
lore.uncommon: Boils over the moment the cook turns their back for a second.
lore.rare: Rattles its lid so loudly that the whole house knows dinner is nearly ready.
lore.epic: Made so much stew for a family party that the leftovers lasted a week.
lore.legendary: Made a stew so big and so good that the whole street came round with bowls.

names.legendary: The Pie That Was Shared With Everyone

lore.common: Has a golden pastry lid with little steam holes in the shape of a smiley face.
lore.uncommon: Bubbles gravy out of its edges and onto the oven floor.
lore.rare: Lets out such a delicious smell that everyone in the house is at the table before it's out.
lore.epic: Was cut open at dinner, and the steam fogged up every pair of glasses at the table.
lore.legendary: Was shared with so many people that every slice was tiny, and everyone still said it was delicious.

names.legendary: The Boiler That Never Broke Down

lore.common: Gurgles in the cupboard every morning as it warms up the house.
lore.uncommon: Clanks so loudly when it turns on that everyone thinks someone is knocking.
lore.rare: Decides by itself whether the shower will be hot or cold today.
lore.epic: Went quiet on the coldest day of the year, and the whole family huddled in one bed.
lore.legendary: Kept a house warm for thirty winters without one breakdown, and got a thank-you card on its birthday.

names.legendary: The Blanket That Kept a House Warm

lore.common: Hums faintly under the sheet and makes the bed warm before anyone gets in.
lore.uncommon: Gets left on until the bed is too hot to lie on, so its owner sleeps on top.
lore.rare: Warms the bed so nicely that nobody in the family wants to get up in the morning.
lore.epic: Kept a whole family snug when the heating broke, and they all slept on one bed.
lore.legendary: Has warmed so many winter nights that the cat now waits beside the plug for it to be switched on.

names.legendary: The Cover That Kept Off the Frost

lore.common: Wraps the duvet in warmth and makes the whole bed feel like a cosy nest.
lore.uncommon: Takes ages to warm up, then becomes too warm to sleep under.
lore.rare: Makes a bed so warm that the cat moves in and refuses to leave.
lore.epic: Turned a cold bedroom into a sauna on the first frost of winter.
lore.legendary: Kept a family warm on the coldest night of the year, and the frost outside never got in.

names.legendary: The Heater Everyone Gathered Round

lore.common: Glows orange in the corner and warms the toes of whoever sits nearest.
lore.uncommon: Makes a faint dusty smell the first time it is switched on each winter.
lore.rare: Draws every person in the room to sit round it in a little circle.
lore.epic: Was fought over in a cold office until it was put in the middle and everybody shared it.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole village hall warm during a snowstorm, and the choir sang it a song.

names.legendary: The Furnace That Warmed the Street

lore.common: Rumbles in the basement and sends warm air whooshing through the vents.
lore.uncommon: Starts up with a loud whump that makes the whole house jump.
lore.rare: Pushes warm air so hard that the curtains flutter by every vent.
lore.epic: Rumbled through a cold snap so steadily that the neighbours came round to warm up.
lore.legendary: Warmed the whole house through a week of snowstorms, and the snowmen outside started to melt.

names.legendary: The Heater That Saved the Barbecue

lore.common: Clicks three times before its little blue flame comes on.
lore.uncommon: Clicks and clicks on cold mornings, always taking longer than anyone wants.
lore.rare: Glows so warmly on the patio that people stay outside long after dark.
lore.epic: Kept a summer barbecue going through a sudden cold evening, and nobody went inside.
lore.legendary: Warmed a whole outdoor wedding so well that the guests danced in their summer clothes in October.

names.legendary: The Pad That Soothed Every Ache

lore.common: Warms up on a sore back or a cold tummy and makes everything feel a bit better.
lore.uncommon: Gets tangled in its cord whenever someone rolls over.
lore.rare: Soothes aches so well that its owner falls asleep in seconds.
lore.epic: Was passed round a whole family with colds, and everyone said it helped the most.
lore.legendary: Has soothed so many aches that the dog now lies on it whenever it gets the chance.

names.legendary: The Heater That Warmed a Winter

lore.common: Has fins like a giant toast rack and takes forever to warm up.
lore.uncommon: Ticks and pings as it heats, like it's counting under its breath.
lore.rare: Stays warm so long after it is turned off that people keep sitting next to it.
lore.epic: Warmed a cold bedroom so well that the sleeper took off their bobble hat for the first time all winter.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole family warm through the coldest winter in years without ever running out of heat.

names.legendary: The Tank That Filled Every Bath

lore.common: Gurgles in its cupboard and heats water for baths and washing up.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of hot water exactly when the last person gets in the shower.
lore.rare: Heats water so quickly that the bath is ready before the bubbles are found.
lore.epic: Filled every bath in the house on a muddy football day without running cold.
lore.legendary: Ran a bath so perfect that a grandad stayed in it until he was as wrinkly as a raisin and twice as happy.

names.legendary: The Fryer That Crisped Everything

lore.common: Whooshes hot air round its basket and smells of chips for days.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when the food is ready, then again a minute later, just in case.
lore.rare: Crisps anything put inside so well that even the vegetables taste like chips.
lore.epic: Made so many chips for a sleepover that the whole street smelled like a chip shop.
lore.legendary: Crisped every food in the house in one day, including a sprout the children actually ate.

names.legendary: The Fryer That Made the Perfect Chip

lore.common: Bubbles away on the counter, and only grown-ups are allowed anywhere near it.
lore.uncommon: Makes the whole house smell of chips for two days after every use.
lore.rare: Crisps chips so perfectly that the whole family hovers by the kitchen door.
lore.epic: Made so many chips for a birthday tea that the guests took bags home like party favours.
lore.legendary: Fried a chip so golden and perfect that the family framed a photo of it before eating it.

names.legendary: The Cooker That Boiled Every Egg

lore.common: Holds six eggs in little cups and beeps when they are ready.
lore.uncommon: Beeps so loudly that everyone in the house thinks the smoke alarm went off.
lore.rare: Steams eggs so precisely that each one comes out exactly as asked.
lore.epic: Boiled eggs for a whole egg-and-spoon race, and every runner got a perfect one.
lore.legendary: Boiled a thousand eggs exactly right, and the hens came to the window to applaud.

names.legendary: The Cooker That Made Stew in Minutes

lore.common: Hisses and whistles on the cooker like a train about to leave.
lore.uncommon: Locks its lid so firmly that the cook has to wait until it is ready.
lore.rare: Cooks so fast that dinner is ready before the table is set.
lore.epic: Whistled so loudly at teatime that the neighbours checked if a train was passing.
lore.legendary: Made a whole day's stew in ten minutes, and the family had time for a game before dinner.

names.legendary: The Cooker That Never Burned the Rice

lore.common: Bubbles quietly with its lid fogged, clicking to warm mode when it's done.
lore.uncommon: Keeps rice warm for so long that the bottom becomes a crispy cake.
lore.rare: Cooks rice so fluffy that every grain stands up on its own.
lore.epic: Cooked enough rice for a family feast, and there was still a bowl left for breakfast.
lore.legendary: Cooked rice every day for twenty years and never burned a single grain.

names.legendary: The Cooker That Cooked Overnight

lore.common: Simmers all day long while everyone is out at school and work.
lore.uncommon: Fills the house with such a strong smell that visitors arrive hungry.
lore.rare: Makes meat so soft that it falls apart when a fork looks at it.
lore.epic: Welcomed a family home from a long day with a smell so good that they skipped their coats.
lore.legendary: Cooked a whole Sunday dinner overnight while everyone slept, and woke them with the smell.

names.legendary: The Steamer That Fed a Banquet

lore.common: Stacks its baskets in a tower and puffs steam out of the top.
lore.uncommon: Fogs up the kitchen windows so the cook can't see the garden.
lore.rare: Steams vegetables so perfectly that even the broccoli gets eaten.
lore.epic: Filled the kitchen with so much steam that the dog went out to see what was cooking.
lore.legendary: Steamed dumplings for a whole banquet, and every guest asked for the recipe.

names.legendary: The Maker That Never Went Sour

lore.common: Keeps little pots of milk warm overnight until they turn into yoghurt.
lore.uncommon: Takes so long that everyone forgets it is there until breakfast.
lore.rare: Makes yoghurt so thick that the spoon stands up in it.
lore.epic: Made yoghurt for every breakfast for a month, and the whole family started to love fruit.
lore.legendary: Made a batch so perfect that it was asked to teach the supermarket a lesson.

names.legendary: The Glove That Never Lost a Round

lore.common: Is padded and puffy and smells a bit like the inside of a gym bag.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck on one hand, so its owner has to unlace it with their teeth.
lore.rare: Bounces off the punching bag so hard that it nearly knocks its wearer over.
lore.epic: Was left in a gym bag over the holidays and cleared the changing room when it was unzipped.
lore.legendary: Won every practice round for a whole club, and was hung on the wall with a gold ribbon.

names.legendary: The Mitt That Saved Sunday Lunch

lore.common: Hangs by the oven looking like a sleepy fish puppet.
lore.uncommon: Has a tiny hole by the thumb that somebody always finds the hard way.
lore.rare: Lets its wearer lift the hottest tray as if it were a cold plate.
lore.epic: Rescued a roast just in time, and the whole family cheered at the oven door.
lore.legendary: Saved a Sunday lunch, a birthday cake and a tray of cookies, all in one afternoon.

names.legendary: The Spatula That Flipped a Record

lore.common: Scrapes the last of the cake mix from the bowl, which everyone wants to lick.
lore.uncommon: Melts a tiny bit on one edge from being left in the pan.
lore.rare: Flips anything it touches, including things that didn't need flipping.
lore.epic: Flipped a pancake right off the plate, across the kitchen and into the dog's bowl.
lore.legendary: Flipped two hundred pancakes in one morning, and the record still stands.

names.legendary: The Machine That Popped a Mountain

lore.common: Pops corn noisily under its dome until the bowl overflows.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a few unpopped kernels at the bottom that nobody wants.
lore.rare: Pops corn so wildly that some of it escapes across the room.
lore.epic: Popped so much corn on film night that the sofa was buried and the film forgotten.
lore.legendary: Popped enough corn for a whole cinema, and the cinema asked to borrow it.

names.legendary: The Toaster That Made a Perfect Toastie

lore.common: Squashes a sandwich into a crispy triangle with crimped edges.
lore.uncommon: Oozes melted cheese out of its sides and onto the counter.
lore.rare: Makes the inside so hot that every toastie must cool down for five minutes.
lore.epic: Oozed so much cheese at a sleepover that the counter looked like a volcano had erupted.
lore.legendary: Made a toastie so perfect that a whole family argued over who got the last bite.

names.legendary: The Whisk That Beat Every Egg

lore.common: Has a bunch of wire loops that clink against the side of the bowl.
lore.uncommon: Sprays tiny drops of batter across the counter when it whisks too fast.
lore.rare: Beats eggs into such tall peaks that the bowl can be held upside down.
lore.epic: Whisked a meringue so big that it towered over the kitchen counter like a cloud.
lore.legendary: Beat every egg for a giant birthday cake by hand, and never got tired once.

names.legendary: The Dish That Was Licked Clean

lore.common: Sits in the oven with the lasagne, bubbling at the edges.
lore.uncommon: Has crispy bits in the corners that everyone fights over.
lore.rare: Bakes its corners so crispy that they have to be chiselled out.
lore.epic: Was so full of lasagne at a family dinner that it took three people to lift it.
lore.legendary: Was licked so clean after a dinner party that it went back in the cupboard without being washed.

names.legendary: The Tray That Baked Every Biscuit

lore.common: Comes out of the oven covered in biscuits and slightly bent.
lore.uncommon: Bangs loudly in the oven whenever it gets hot and warps.
lore.rare: Bakes biscuits so evenly that the whole tray is perfect, every single time.
lore.epic: Baked so many biscuits for a school sale that the tins ran out before the biscuits did.
lore.legendary: Has baked so many biscuits that it can smell when they're ready before the timer goes.

names.legendary: The Grill That Fed the Neighbourhood

lore.common: Smokes and sizzles in the garden, sending lovely smells over every fence.
lore.uncommon: Takes so long to heat up that everyone has eaten crisps before the sausages are on.
lore.rare: Sends smoke wherever people sit, no matter where they move their chairs.
lore.epic: Sent such a big smoke cloud over the fence that the neighbours came over with buns.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole neighbourhood at a street party and every sausage was perfectly cooked.

names.legendary: The Mat That Soaked Up a Flood

lore.common: Lies by the bath waiting for dripping feet to step on it.
lore.uncommon: Stays damp for a whole day after somebody's long bath.
lore.rare: Soaks up so much water that it squelches with every step.
lore.epic: Soaked up a whole bath-time splash fight and held the puddle like a sponge.
lore.legendary: Soaked up an entire overflowing bath, and the ceiling below didn't get a single drip.

names.legendary: The Scale That Always Said Lovely

lore.common: Blinks a number up at its user and waits for a reaction.
lore.uncommon: Shows a different number each time, depending on its mood.
lore.rare: Makes its user step off and on again five times to check.
lore.epic: Was stood on by the whole family and the dog at once, and showed only "oh dear".
lore.legendary: Was so kind that it only ever showed the word "lovely" to everyone who stepped on it.

names.legendary: The Opener That Never Went Missing

lore.common: Pops caps off bottles with a satisfying fizz and clink.
lore.uncommon: Is always in the last drawer anyone looks in.
lore.rare: Flicks bottle caps across the room like tiny flying saucers.
lore.epic: Opened every bottle at a picnic so fast that the caps rained on the blanket.
lore.legendary: Has been in the same drawer for forty years and has never once gone missing.

names.legendary: The Dish That Kept Butter Perfect

lore.common: Keeps the butter covered and slightly too hard to spread.
lore.uncommon: Has its lid stuck down by old butter every other morning.
lore.rare: Lets butter go soft so fast in summer that it slides across the plate.
lore.epic: Let the butter slide off the table on a hot day, and the dog found it first.
lore.legendary: Kept the butter perfectly spreadable through a heatwave, and toast everywhere was saved.

names.legendary: The Tin That Baked Every Birthday

lore.common: Has a little clip on the side that lets the cake out when it's cooled.
lore.uncommon: Sticks the cake's edges to its side so it comes out a bit lopsided.
lore.rare: Bakes cakes so evenly that they come out flat on top every time.
lore.epic: Let a birthday cake escape onto the floor, and it still tasted delicious.
lore.legendary: Has baked every family birthday cake for thirty years without a single one sinking.

names.legendary: The Opener That Never Slipped

lore.common: Cranks its way round a can and lifts the lid like a little hat.
lore.uncommon: Slips off halfway round every single time.
lore.rare: Grips cans so tight that only the strongest wrist can turn it.
lore.epic: Took twenty minutes to open a can of beans, and breakfast became lunch.
lore.legendary: Opened every can in the cupboard without slipping once, and the beans were amazed.

names.legendary: The Dish That Fed a Wedding

lore.common: Comes out of the oven so heavy that whoever carries it walks like a penguin.
lore.uncommon: Keeps food hot for so long that the last serving is still steaming an hour later.
lore.rare: Bubbles so much in the oven that its lid lifts up and down like it's breathing.
lore.epic: Fed the whole family three nights in a row, and nobody complained once.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole wedding party with one stew, and there was still enough for seconds.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Was Never Empty Enough

lore.common: Holds the cat's breakfast and gets judged every morning.
lore.uncommon: Gets pushed across the floor by a cat who wants more food in it.
lore.rare: Looks empty to the cat even when it is completely full.
lore.epic: Was rattled at dawn by the cat until every person in the house woke up.
lore.legendary: Was refilled so many times in one day that the cat finally said thank you.

names.legendary: The Dish That Fed a Thousand Guests

lore.common: Keeps scrambled eggs warm for the breakfast buffet with a little flame underneath.
lore.uncommon: Lifts its lid with a squeak every time a guest peers inside.
lore.rare: Keeps food warm for so long that the last guest gets the best bit.
lore.epic: Kept breakfast warm for a whole hotel of hungry tourists, and nobody went cold.
lore.legendary: Fed a thousand guests at a grand dinner and still had enough left for the staff.

names.legendary: The Board That Held Every Cheese

lore.common: Holds wedges of cheese and a small knife that keeps falling off.
lore.uncommon: Has little cuts all over from every cheese ever sliced on it.
lore.rare: Makes guests hover round it all night, nibbling and saying "just one more".
lore.epic: Was raided by guests so quickly that only the grapes were left.
lore.legendary: Held a cheese from every country in the world at one party, and nobody could pick a favourite.

names.legendary: The Grater That Grated a Mountain

lore.common: Stands on the counter in four sides, each one rougher than the last.
lore.uncommon: Keeps a few shreds of cheese stuck inside that nobody can reach.
lore.rare: Grates cheese so fast that a whole block disappears in seconds.
lore.epic: Grated so much cheese on spaghetti night that the pasta vanished under a cheesy snowdrift.
lore.legendary: Grated a whole wheel of cheese for a village pasta party without stopping once.

names.legendary: The Sticks That Lifted One Grain

lore.common: Work as a pair and won't do anything if one goes missing.
lore.uncommon: Cross over at the wrong moment and drop the dumpling back in the bowl.
lore.rare: Pinch food so precisely that they can pick up a single pea.
lore.epic: Started a noodle slurping contest at dinner that ended with everyone splashed.
lore.legendary: Lifted a single grain of rice to a grandma's mouth, and the whole table clapped.

names.legendary: The Pan That Made a Paper-Thin Crepe

lore.common: Is so flat that the batter has to be swirled round it quickly.
lore.uncommon: Makes the first crepe a mess, every single time.
lore.rare: Spreads batter so thin that the crepes are almost see-through.
lore.epic: Made crepes for a whole party and was still swirling at midnight.
lore.legendary: Made a crepe so thin that the family could read the newspaper through it.

names.legendary: The Board That Sliced a Feast

lore.common: Is covered in knife marks and smells faintly of onions.
lore.uncommon: Slides across the counter whenever someone chops too quickly.
lore.rare: Holds so much chopped veg that it all spills onto the floor at once.
lore.epic: Prepped a salad for a whole party, and the guests were too full for pudding.
lore.legendary: Has had so many feasts prepped on it that its knife marks spell out a recipe.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Was Licked Shiny

lore.common: Gets licked so clean that it shines like a mirror.
lore.uncommon: Gets carried round the house by a dog who wants dinner early.
lore.rare: Sloshes water everywhere when a thirsty dog drinks from it.
lore.epic: Was dropped at the owner's feet so loudly that dinner came ten minutes early.
lore.legendary: Has been licked so many times that it shines bright enough to signal ships.

names.legendary: The Mat That Kept the House Clean

lore.common: Lies by the door with WELCOME written on it, and gets ignored by every boot.
lore.uncommon: Curls up at one corner so that everyone trips on it.
lore.rare: Holds so much mud after a rainy day that it could grow potatoes.
lore.epic: Caught every muddy boot at a party, and the carpets stayed perfectly clean.
lore.legendary: Kept a house so clean for ten years that the hoover took early retirement.

names.legendary: The Grill That Made Rainy Day Barbecues

lore.common: Makes stripes on sausages and grumbles when it gets too greasy.
lore.uncommon: Drips fat into its tray, which nobody ever remembers to empty.
lore.rare: Makes indoor food taste so much like a barbecue that people go outside to eat it.
lore.epic: Hosted a barbecue in the kitchen on a rainy day, and the smoke alarm joined in.
lore.legendary: Gave a whole family summer barbecues all through a rainy year without a single sunny day.

names.legendary: The Mat That Was Unrolled Every Day

lore.common: Rolls out on the lounge floor and curls back up at each end.
lore.uncommon: Is always rolled the wrong way, so it never lies flat.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who unrolls it suddenly feel like stretching.
lore.epic: Was used for a family workout that ended with everyone lying flat and laughing.
lore.legendary: Was unrolled every morning for ten years and taught a whole family to touch their toes.

names.legendary: The Pot That Never Lost a Fork

lore.common: Bubbles with melted cheese and holds a ring of long forks round its edge.
lore.uncommon: Swallows one cube of bread from every fork that dips into it.
lore.rare: Bubbles so thick that bread cubes sink and need a fishing trip to retrieve.
lore.epic: Swallowed so many bread cubes at a party that the guests had to fish with spoons.
lore.legendary: Kept a party dipping for five hours and never lost a single fork in the cheese.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Was Always Full

lore.common: Holds apples, bananas and one orange that nobody wants.
lore.uncommon: Gathers a few little fruit flies on warm days.
lore.rare: Ripens everything inside it at once, so it's all soft by Friday.
lore.epic: Attracted so many fruit flies that the kitchen looked like a tiny airport.
lore.legendary: Was always full of fresh fruit, no matter how much the family ate.

names.legendary: The Funnel That Never Spilled a Drop

lore.common: Pours liquids into tiny bottles without spilling, most of the time.
lore.uncommon: Overflows whenever somebody pours a bit too fast.
lore.rare: Pours so smoothly that the bottle fills up quicker than anyone expects.
lore.epic: Overflowed while filling a jug, and the counter became a lake.
lore.legendary: Filled a thousand bottles in one day without spilling a single drop.

names.legendary: The Press That Squeezed a Festival

lore.common: Squeezes garlic through tiny holes, and the rest stays stuck inside forever.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its user's fingers smelling of garlic for the rest of the day.
lore.rare: Squeezes garlic so strongly that the whole kitchen smells of it for a week.
lore.epic: Squeezed so much garlic for garlic bread that the whole street could smell it.
lore.legendary: Squeezed every clove at a garlic festival, and the whole town smelled so strongly that the moths moved away.

names.legendary: The Griddle That Fed a Campsite

lore.common: Is a wide flat pan with room for six pancakes and an egg on the side.
lore.uncommon: Is always hotter on one side, so the pancakes cook at different speeds.
lore.rare: Cooks so much at once that the cook can't keep up with flipping.
lore.epic: Made a fry-up for the whole family on a Sunday, and the dog got the last sausage.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole campsite breakfast in one go, and every tent came out to queue.

names.legendary: The Grill That Forgot the Toast

lore.common: Glows at the top of the oven and makes toast while the cook looks away.
lore.uncommon: Toasts one side of the bread perfectly and leaves the other side white.
lore.rare: Turns cheese on toast from golden to charcoal in the time it takes to sneeze.
lore.epic: Sent so much smoke from forgotten toast that the smoke alarm cheered it on.
lore.legendary: Toasted the perfect slice once, golden on both sides, and the family still talks about it.

names.legendary: The Plate That Cooked Every Meal

lore.common: Has one ring that glows red, and is the whole kitchen for somebody living in a tiny flat.
lore.uncommon: Takes ages to heat and ages to cool, so the kettle is always waiting.
lore.rare: Cooks everything on one ring by taking turns, so dinner arrives in instalments.
lore.epic: Cooked a whole three-course dinner on one ring, and the guests clapped after each course.
lore.legendary: Cooked every meal for a student for three years and saw them graduate.

names.legendary: The Hob That Boiled in Seconds

lore.common: Is flat and black and only heats pans that it likes the feel of.
lore.uncommon: Beeps angrily whenever a wet spoon is placed on top of it.
lore.rare: Boils water so fast that the pasta isn't ready to go in yet.
lore.epic: Boiled a pan so quickly that the cook's tea wasn't made when the pasta was done.
lore.legendary: Boiled water in three seconds flat, and the kettle sulked in the corner for a week.

names.legendary: The Grill That Smoked a Summer

lore.common: Sits round and black in the garden like a giant beetle with a lid.
lore.uncommon: Puffs smoke out of its vents in the direction of the washing line.
lore.rare: Smokes food so slowly that the whole afternoon disappears waiting for it.
lore.epic: Smoked a joint of meat all day, and the neighbours came over at teatime just to sniff.
lore.legendary: Smoked so many summer dinners that the garden still smells of them in December.

names.legendary: The Scale That Weighed a Feather

lore.common: Shows numbers in grams and beeps whenever it's touched.
lore.uncommon: Switches itself off halfway through weighing the flour.
lore.rare: Is so precise that it shows a change when someone breathes on it.
lore.epic: Switched off mid-bake, and the cake turned into a biscuit.
lore.legendary: Weighed a single feather, a grain of sugar and a whisker, all correctly on the same day.

names.legendary: The Plate That Spun Every Dish

lore.common: Spins in the middle of the table so everyone can reach the sauces.
lore.uncommon: Spins the wrong way just when someone is reaching for the soy sauce.
lore.rare: Spins so freely that a gentle push sends dinner round the table three times.
lore.epic: Was spun so hard at a family dinner that the noodles flew off and landed on grandad.
lore.legendary: Spun every dish to every guest at a banquet without spilling a drop.

names.legendary: The Cup That Never Mismeasured

lore.common: Has little lines up its side that nobody reads properly.
lore.uncommon: Gets used for sugar and then for flour without being washed in between.
lore.rare: Makes every recipe turn out perfectly, as long as somebody actually reads the lines.
lore.epic: Was overfilled for a cake, and the sponge rose until it touched the oven roof.
lore.legendary: Measured every ingredient for a whole bakery for thirty years and never got one wrong.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Mixed Every Cake

lore.common: Is so shiny inside that the baker sees a stretched, silly face every time they look in.
lore.uncommon: Spins on the counter when someone stirs too enthusiastically.
lore.rare: Rings so loudly when dropped that the whole house thinks something broke.
lore.epic: Was dropped during a baking day and rang for a whole minute while everyone covered their ears.
lore.legendary: Mixed every family cake for forty years, and still shines like it is brand new.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Ground a Spice Road

lore.common: Sits heavy on the counter, with a stone stick that grinds spices.
lore.uncommon: Clunks loudly when its pestle is dropped back inside.
lore.rare: Grinds spices so finely that they float out of the bowl like smoke.
lore.epic: Pounded so many spices for a curry night that the whole house sneezed.
lore.legendary: Ground spices for a whole market for fifty years, and still smells of every single one.

names.legendary: The Pad That Carried a Million Clicks

lore.common: Lies under the mouse and gets doodled on during long phone calls.
lore.uncommon: Curls up at the corner, so the mouse keeps slipping off the edge.
lore.rare: Is so smooth that the cursor zooms across the screen with the tiniest nudge.
lore.epic: Was doodled on so much during a long meeting that it became an art exhibit.
lore.legendary: Has carried a million clicks under its mouse and still lies perfectly flat.

names.legendary: The Tin That Baked a Bake Sale

lore.common: Has twelve little holes and always one muffin that comes out wonky.
lore.uncommon: Sticks the bottom of every muffin unless it's greased twice.
lore.rare: Makes muffins rise so high that they become one big muffin across the top.
lore.epic: Baked so many muffins for a bake sale that the tables ran out first.
lore.legendary: Baked every muffin for a whole school's bake sale, and the school roof was paid for with crumbs.

names.legendary: The Clippers That Never Flicked a Nail

lore.common: Clips with a sharp little click and flings the clipping somewhere unknown.
lore.uncommon: Flings nail clippings to places nobody will find until spring cleaning.
lore.rare: Snips so cleanly that nails come out perfectly smooth.
lore.epic: Flung a clipping so far it landed in a cup of tea across the room.
lore.legendary: Clipped every nail in a family of six without flinging a single clipping out of the bin.

names.legendary: The Cracker That Opened Every Nut

lore.common: Cracks nuts with a loud snap and sends shells across the floor.
lore.uncommon: Snaps a walnut into dust instead of two neat halves.
lore.rare: Cracks the toughest nut so hard that the kernel flies across the room.
lore.epic: Cracked so many nuts by the fireside that the dog had shells in his fur for a week.
lore.legendary: Cracked every nut in a giant bowl at a family party without crushing a single kernel.

names.legendary: The Pan That Fed a Whole Fiesta

lore.common: Is so wide that it hangs off the edge of the hob on both sides.
lore.uncommon: Has a crispy layer stuck to the bottom that everybody fights over.
lore.rare: Cooks so much rice at once that the cook has to stir with a garden spade.
lore.epic: Cooked for a whole street party, and the queue went round the block.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole village fiesta from one pan, and the crispy bit was shared by everyone.

names.legendary: The Stick That Crushed a Harvest

lore.common: Is a heavy little club that pounds spices into powder.
lore.uncommon: Rolls off the counter at the slightest nudge and lands on a toe.
lore.rare: Pounds so hard that the bowl beneath it rings for minutes.
lore.epic: Was used as a drumstick at a kitchen party, and the pans kept the beat.
lore.legendary: Crushed a whole harvest of herbs for a festival, and the market smelled sweet for a week.

names.legendary: The Bowl Everyone Was Waiting For

lore.common: Holds pet biscuits and gets nosed round the kitchen floor.
lore.uncommon: Rattles so loudly when picked up that every pet comes running.
lore.rare: Brings every animal in the house to the kitchen the moment it is touched.
lore.epic: Was rattled at teatime, and the cat, the dog and a neighbour's rabbit all arrived.
lore.legendary: Has been filled so many times that the pets know the time without a clock.

names.legendary: The Dish That Baked the Prize Pie

lore.common: Has a crinkled edge where the pastry is pressed down with a fork.
lore.uncommon: Bubbles fruit juice over the edge and onto the oven floor.
lore.rare: Bakes pastry so crisp that it shatters with a crunch at the first cut.
lore.epic: Overflowed with apple pie juice, and the kitchen smelled like a bakery for a week.
lore.legendary: Baked a pie that won the village show three years in a row.

names.legendary: The Masher That Never Left a Lump

lore.common: Squashes potatoes with a satisfying squelch and a little splash.
lore.uncommon: Always leaves one hidden lump in the bottom of the pan.
lore.rare: Mashes potatoes so hard that they splatter onto the ceiling.
lore.epic: Mashed so many potatoes for a roast dinner that the bowl overflowed onto the table.
lore.legendary: Mashed potatoes so perfectly smooth that the whole family asked for seconds of mash only.

names.legendary: The Ramekin That Rose a Perfect Souffle

lore.common: Is a tiny white pot that holds just enough pudding for one.
lore.uncommon: Comes out of the oven so hot that nobody can pick it up for ages.
lore.rare: Makes every pudding look fancy, even when it's just custard.
lore.epic: Made a souffle rise so tall that it peeked out of the oven door.
lore.legendary: Rose a souffle so perfect that the chef cried and the whole restaurant clapped.

names.legendary: The Tin That Made Every Roast

lore.common: Sizzles in the oven holding potatoes, a roast and plenty of gravy juices.
lore.uncommon: Is too big for the sink and always gets left to soak overnight.
lore.rare: Roasts potatoes so crispy that everyone tries to steal the crunchy ones.
lore.epic: Roasted so many potatoes on a Sunday that the family ate leftovers for three days.
lore.legendary: Roasted the perfect Sunday dinner every week for forty years.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Tossed Every Salad

lore.common: Holds a big leafy salad and smells faintly of olive oil.
lore.uncommon: Lets lettuce leaves escape whenever someone tosses too hard.
lore.rare: Tosses a salad so well that every leaf gets the same amount of dressing.
lore.epic: Tossed a salad at a party so high that the lettuce landed on the guests.
lore.legendary: Has tossed so many salads that it makes even the grumpiest child eat a tomato.

names.legendary: The Spinner That Dried Every Leaf

lore.common: Spins lettuce dry with a whirring, clattering roar.
lore.uncommon: Flings water out of the gap in its lid onto the cook's shirt.
lore.rare: Spins so fast that the lettuce comes out dry as paper.
lore.epic: Was spun so wildly at a barbecue that it walked off the table by itself.
lore.legendary: Dried every leaf for a whole wedding salad in under a minute.

names.legendary: The Lid That Fitted Every Pan

lore.common: Sits on top of the saucepan and rattles when the water boils.
lore.uncommon: Falls off the shelf and clatters on the floor whenever the cupboard opens.
lore.rare: Rattles so loudly that the cook can hear it from the garden.
lore.epic: Fell off at dinner, and the clatter made the whole family jump.
lore.legendary: Fitted every saucepan in the kitchen, which no lid has ever managed.

names.legendary: The Scale That Was Always Right

lore.common: Has a needle that wobbles back and forth before it settles.
lore.uncommon: Shows a different weight every time it's used, depending on the angle.
lore.rare: Wobbles for so long that everyone forgets what they were weighing.
lore.epic: Was used to weigh a cake, a cat and a baby in one afternoon.
lore.legendary: Was so accurate that the town's market used it to check all the other scales.

names.legendary: The Bowl Passed Round Every Table

lore.common: Gets passed round the table until it reaches whoever wants the last spoonful.
lore.uncommon: Is too heavy to pass with one hand, so it gets dropped onto the table with a thud.
lore.rare: Holds so much food that the table looks like a feast even with just one dish.
lore.epic: Was passed round so many times at a family dinner that it got dizzy.
lore.legendary: Has been passed round so many tables that it knows every family's favourite dish.

names.legendary: The Tray That Carried Every Treat

lore.common: Carries cups, plates and biscuits all at once, balanced on two hands.
lore.uncommon: Tilts at the worst moment, so the teacups slide to one end.
lore.rare: Carries so much at once that the carrier has to walk very slowly.
lore.epic: Carried breakfast in bed on a birthday, and every crumb stayed on.
lore.legendary: Has carried a thousand birthday breakfasts and never spilled a single cup of tea.

names.legendary: The Smoker That Cooked a Whole Day

lore.common: Puffs out sweet woody smoke all afternoon in the corner of the garden.
lore.uncommon: Sends smoke drifting over the fence just as the neighbours put out washing.
lore.rare: Cooks food so slowly that it's ready the day after it's started.
lore.epic: Smoked so much food for a party that the garden looked like a misty morning.
lore.legendary: Smoked a meal so good that a whole town queued for a taste.

names.legendary: The Basket That Steamed a Banquet

lore.common: Sits over a pan of boiling water and fills the kitchen with soft steam.
lore.uncommon: Lets dumplings stick to its bottom unless lined with a leaf.
lore.rare: Steams so quickly that the dumplings are ready before the plates are out.
lore.epic: Was stacked so high for a dim sum lunch that it nearly touched the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Steamed a whole banquet for a family celebration, and every dumpling was perfect.

names.legendary: The Pot That Fed a Village

lore.common: Is so big that it needs two hands, a strong back and a lot of water.
lore.uncommon: Simmers on the cooker all day and fogs up every window.
lore.rare: Holds so much soup that the family eats it for a week.
lore.epic: Made so much soup for a party that the guests left with jars.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole village after a storm, and every bowl was hot and full.

names.legendary: The Stove That Cooked Every Dinner

lore.common: Has four rings, and the one that works best is always in use.
lore.uncommon: Clicks and clicks before its gas catches with a soft whoomph.
lore.rare: Cooks four things at once, so the cook needs four hands.
lore.epic: Cooked a whole family feast on four rings at once, and not a single pan boiled over.
lore.legendary: Cooked so many dinners that its knobs now turn themselves to the right setting when someone says what's for tea.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Sweetened Every Tea

lore.common: Holds sugar and a little spoon that always ends up sticky.
lore.uncommon: Gets a wet teaspoon stuck in it, so the sugar forms lumps.
lore.rare: Spills sugar across the table every time it is passed.
lore.epic: Was knocked over at a tea party, and the ants held a party of their own.
lore.legendary: Has sweetened so many cups of tea that the teapot thinks it's a member of the family.

names.legendary: The Pot That Stewed a Feast

lore.common: Has a tall pointed lid like a wizard's hat that keeps the steam inside.
lore.uncommon: Gets its lid lifted by everyone who walks past, just to have a sniff.
lore.rare: Makes stew so tender that it melts the moment it touches a fork.
lore.epic: Stewed so slowly at a party that the guests had played three games before eating.
lore.legendary: Stewed a feast so delicious that the whole street gathered at the window to sniff.

names.legendary: The Tongs That Never Dropped a Sausage

lore.common: Clack together twice before every grab, as if warming up.
lore.uncommon: Drop the sausage right before it reaches the plate.
lore.rare: Grab everything in reach, including the cook's sleeve.
lore.epic: Clacked so loudly at a barbecue that every guest copied them with their hands.
lore.legendary: Turned a hundred sausages at a barbecue without ever dropping one.

names.legendary: The Tweezers That Found Every Splinter

lore.common: Pinch things that are too small for fingers, like splinters and tiny beads.
lore.uncommon: Drop whatever they've picked up just as it's lifted.
lore.rare: Find splinters that nobody else can even see.
lore.epic: Found a splinter after a whole family search with a torch.
lore.legendary: Removed every splinter from a whole scout troop after one woodland adventure.

names.legendary: The Mat That Taught a Family to Bend

lore.common: Rolls out with a slap and smells faintly of rubber.
lore.uncommon: Curls back up while its owner is trying to do a stretch.
lore.rare: Makes anyone standing on it feel calm and suddenly flexible.
lore.epic: Was used for a family yoga session that ended with everyone stuck in a pretzel.
lore.legendary: Taught a whole family to touch their toes, including the grandad who had not done so in forty years.
